# Slipvolt — treasury-funded Gonka access

Hold a configured Solana project token; authenticate with a signed message;
create a revocable customer API key; use a capped daily AI input+output allowance.
No on-chain key mint or second checkout. Coins stay in the wallet.
Stage and limits: GET /api/status
Source-labeled catalog: GET /api/models
Live catalog: GET /v1/models (503 when verification unavailable)
Authenticated allowance/usage: GET /api/membership
Create customer key: POST /api/member-key (signed cookie + same-origin request)
List/revoke keys: GET /api/keys, DELETE /api/keys/{id}
Inference: POST /v1/chat/completions, Bearer sv_... (legacy grd_ recognized)
Text-only Chat Completions; stream=true supports SSE with final usage.
Function tool definitions and returned tool calls are supported; Slipvolt never executes tools.
Multimodal inputs, embeddings, Responses, Assistants and non-schema fields are not supported.
Exact schema: GET /openapi.json

GET /api/network: sanitized cached aggregate OpenBroker statistics, NOT project activity.
GET /api/treasury: optional native wallet balance and separately opt-in broker credit.
Never combine those numbers as a verified user entitlement or redemption value.
Never enter an obk- master key into the customer site or request a wallet seed.
The service issues its own keys and keeps the provider credential server-side.
New calls re-check finalized token holdings, available GNK, wallet allowance and
shared global/pool limits. More keys do not multiply a wallet's allowance.
Changing wallets can defeat per-wallet fairness; the global pool remains finite.

Duplicate Idempotency-Key returns 409. Do not retry uncertain requests blindly.
Incomplete streams/uncertain billing retain a hold and require operator review.
No real token mint, deployment, treasury swap, or funded inference is implied.

Customer help: /help/ (setup, compatibility, limits, error recovery and safe support).
Data handling: /privacy/ (prelaunch disclosure; not an end-to-end retention guarantee).
Service rules: /terms/ (draft; not finalized paid-service or token-sale terms).
Daily reset: 00:00 UTC; no rollover; unresolved reservations survive the reset.
Recent usage CSV: GET /api/usage/export (wallet cookie required; latest 100 records only).
Revoke all API keys: POST /api/keys/revoke-all (wallet cookie + same origin).
Sign out all sessions: POST /api/auth/logout-all (separate from key revocation).
Planned metered pricing is not enabled checkout or automatic overage billing.
At the proposed $0.075 input / $0.30 output per-million rates, an 80/20 mix costs
$0.12 per million total tokens; 1 billion represents $120 hypothetical revenue.
Holder usage is funded allowance, not booked metered revenue.
